_doc: tools/vulncheck.py (SPEC EVL-5). go_targets: module directories govulncheck scans. osv_sources: lockfiles the OSV scan must report (it scans every lockfile; these guard against a scan that reads nothing). skip_paths: the control fixture, scanned only by `vulncheck.py control`. accepted: one record per accepted vulnerability, {id (ID or alias), issue (an open issue recording why), why, optional where (Go target or lockfile)}.
